name: TempVars
description: Represents the collection of TempVar objects.
remarks: Use the Add method or the SetTempVar macro action to create a TempVar object. Use the Remove method or the RemoveTempVar macro action to delete a TempVar object from the TempVars collection. Use the RemoveAll method or the RemoveAllTempVars macro action to delete all TempVar objects from the TempVars collection. The TempVars collection can store up to 255 TempVar objects. If you don't remove a TempVar object, it will remain in memory until you close the database. It's a good practice to remove TempVar object variables when you are finished using them. To refer to a TempVar object in a collection by its ordinal number or by its Name property setting, use the following syntax form: - TempVar![name]

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Use the Application property to access the active Microsoft Access Application object and its related properties. Read-only Application object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: The Item property returns a specific member of a collection either by position or by index. Read-only TempVar.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets the number of TempVar objects in the TempVars collection. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Name As String, Value As Variant)
methods.description: Adds a variable to the TempVars collection.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name to use for the TempVar.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The value to store as a TempVar. This value must be a string expression or a numeric expression. Setting this argument to an object data type will result in a run-time error.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes the specified TempVar object from the TempVars collection.

parameters.name: var
parameters.description: An expression that specifies the position of a member of the collection referred to by the _expression_ argument. If a numeric expression, the argument must be a number from 0 to the value of the collection's Count property minus 1. If a string expression, the argument must be the name of a member of the collection.

methods.name: RemoveAll
methods.description: Removes all of the TempVar objects from the TempVars collection.
